hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qEi "rm\s+(-rf|--recursive)\s+/($|\s)|git\s+push\s+--force\s+(origin\s+)?(main|master)|DROP\s+TABLE|DROP\s+DATABASE|mkfs\.|:(){ :|:& };:"; then echo "BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected. Review and confirm manually." >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qEi "\.(env|env\.local|env\.production|pem|key|credentials|secret)$|credentials\.json|service.account\.json"; then echo "BLOCKED: Writing to sensitive file: $FILE" >&2; exit 2; fi'
